scripts.build:linux: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o bin/api-linux-amd64 .
scripts.typecheck: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go tool staticcheck ./...
scripts.lint:openapi: go run github.com/daveshanley/vacuum@v0.33.1 lint --details --fail-severity warn --no-banner --no-style openapi.yaml
